name: 17-flag-supersession-idempotence
description: Flag the same email twice in one session with different intents — second flag supersedes the first (per outbox.ts FlagArgs comment). Then commit and verify only ONE row was processed (the latest intent). Also covers act_on_email returning a fresh action_id per call.

steps.note: step 1 — second flag with different intent supersedes the first
step 2 — third flag, final intent is keep
vault should be empty — final intent was keep
